description: Paired control for covid_first_look_v5: the same seeds and the same three Theta points around the v4 selection, run on the pre-change pooled cabin air (transmission.cabin_air_mode: zone_pool) with the merged observation process (#555). v4 ran the pooled air with the pre-#555 observation process and v5 changes both at once; this arm holds the air fixed so the observation-process effect on the Diamond Princess channels (campaign positives, asymptomatic share, crew share) is separable from the air-architecture effect. Not a fit: three Theta points cannot select, and the arm exists to attribute a difference, not to choose a value.

grid.note: 1e7, 3.16e7 (the v4 selection), 1e8: the v4 interior minimum and its half-decade neighbours, so each cell pairs with a v4 cell at the same (Theta, seed).

held_out.note: Stored for the same pairing; the held-out hull does not declare retest-after-negative, so this arm is expected to reproduce v4 there up to the presentation-only sick call.
